The prior aggregate summed both ops and double-counted one construction (~0.5155 ms/cycle, ~22%): prior quoted totals 2.3187 / 2.4173 ms/cycle are superseded UPPER BOUNDS; the corrected construct-once flow cost is this field set. O(1) artifact write + O(N) index rewrite
O(N artifacts) reads + version scan (per resolve)
O(N capsules * key-set size) scoring + applicability
